bodyHtml:
A concise reading guide to the original source, the discussion's attention signal, and the claims that still need verification.

The short version

Stalwart 1.2.0 speaks MAPI over HTTP, Exchange Web Services, ActiveSync and Autodiscover, so Outlook, Apple Mail and mobile devices connect to it as they would to an Exchange server. Also in this release: mail rules, read receipts, working hours, room and equipment booking, and the new Stalwart CLI 2.0 with an interactive console.

Why it drew attention

The collected source record shows 549 points, 300 comments, and published 2026-11-23.

Points and comments measure interest at one moment; they do not verify the linked article or settle the debate.

What to question

Identify the author's central claim, then look for primary documents, reproducible evidence, corrections, and important missing context.

Distinguish statements in the original article from interpretations added in the comment thread.

Read it in this order

Open the linked source first and note its evidence. Then read the Hacker News comments for counterexamples, corrections, and additional references. Recheck any important conclusion against a primary source.

Bottom line

This discussion is useful as a map of questions and reactions, not as independent proof. The most reliable takeaway comes from comparing Stalwart is now a drop-in replacement for Microsoft Exchange with the primary evidence it cites.
